title: Give task-sync export a supported way to keep sensitive text in completed items off a public data branch
outcome: Give task-sync export a supported way to keep sensitive text in completed items off a public data branch
acceptance: When an export would publish secret, credential or private personal text that sits in a completed item, an operator has a supported remedy short of not publishing: an export-time redaction or exclusion for named items or fields, or a sanctioned redaction-only amendment of completed text
The remedy applies consistently on export and import, so that hosts exchanging a redacted item don't diverge or keep re-exporting the original text, and the redaction is recorded and attributed
The development no-op redactor notice states what the remedy is, and docs/features/task-planning-text.md describes it
